subject_group: 8.11 Fast rope insertion and extraction systems

versions.text:
Standard: The FRIES has a means to jettison the rope and prevent accidental release by incorporating redundant retention features throughout the operating envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct kinematic analysis to verify jettison mechanism ability to prevent accidental release of the rope with and without an external load.
(2) Conduct kinematic analysis to verify jettison mechanism ability to release the rope with and without an external load. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing to verify jettison mechanism can prevent accidental release of the rope with and without an external load.
  (2) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing to verify jettison mechanism ability to release the rope with and without an external load. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Conduct a flight test to verify jettison mechanism can prevent accidental jettison with and without an external load.
  (4) Flight test: Conduct a flight test to verify jettison mechanism ability to release the rope with and without an external load.
